out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at one handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: please provide hand soap for each hand sink.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the @LOCATION@ being used @OBSERVATION@. - OBSERVED: (1) a hand sink was used to store a tray with squeeze bottles of honey, olive oil and vinegar. (2) a hand sink was used to dump ice.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated the CFM and food employees. CFM removed the tray with squeeze bottles.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: - OBSERVED: a food employee rinsed soiled spoons and plates and stored with clean utensils for future use.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated food employees and CFM. EHS prompted CFM to set up 3-compartment sink to wash, rinse and sanitize utensils.

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: - OBSERVED: cheese cake jars (45-46f) were stored in avantco 1-door upright cooler overnight.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM discarded the cheese cake jars. Shotted Specialty Coffee (Inspection Date: 07/24/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: - OBSERVED: squeeze bottles of olive oil, honey and vinegar were not labeled.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS prompted the CFM to properly label all squeeze bottles.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information labeled 'Employee Health Policy.'
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED HARD COPIES OF THE PROCEDURE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the @LOCATION@ is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. HAND SINK AT SERVICE LINE IS BLOCKED BY EQUIPMENT.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CFM WILL NEED TO RELOCATE THE EQUIPMENT. Shotted Specialty Coffee (Inspection Date: 09/09/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PLEASE OBTAIN A FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit.

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine. NO HIGH TEMPERATURE DISHWASHER TESTER.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature.

violations.title: Availability of Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There are no chemical sanitizers for sanitizing equipment and utensils available in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Except for those that are generated on-site, at the time of use, chemical sanitizers that are used to sanitize equipment and utensils shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. QUATERNARY AMMONIA HAS BEEN PROVIDED.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: THE DELIVERY END OF A HOSE ATTACHED TO A HOSE BIBB ON A MOP SINK IS LAYING IN THE MOP SINK BASIN.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. THE HOSE HAS BEEN REMOVED.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PLEASE OBTAIN A FOOD THERMOMETER AND FORWARD THE RECEIPT TO EHS WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: An employee was observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff.

violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. THERE IS NO TEST KIT FOR QUATERNARY AMMONIA.
